news_analysis.headline_hook: Unga Bank Account Rent-ku ₹15,000 Tharom-nu Sonnaangala? ₹6.80 Cr Scam-la 12 Peru Jail-ku Pona Math!
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: Law enforcement arrested the 12th suspect in a ₹6.80 crore fake director scam involving fabricated identities, fraudulent SIM procurement, and mule corporate bank accounts.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Retail investors assume this is an isolated cyber fraud resolved by arresting local operatives, believing corporate MCA records and directorship credentials guarantee institutional legitimacy.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Synthetic corporate entities and 'dummy director' networks are systematically used to layer illicit capital, siphon micro-cap liquidity, and manipulate pre-IPO/penny stock structures before regulators intervene.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Always cross-verify MCA DIN filings, active filing histories, and auditor credentials on MCA21 before deploying capital into unlisted shares or high-yield private placement vehicles.

comparison_data.myth: Retail investors ninaikiradhu: Idhu oru chinna cyber crime, local aaluvingala arrest pannita ellam seri aagirum.
comparison_data.reality: Institutional reality: Idhu oru organized network. Synthetic corporate entities and dummy directors use panni black money-ah white aakkuraanga.

stat_data.label: illegally layered and siphoned capital
stat_data.context: Indha ₹6.80 crore scam-la 12th arrest-ah oru accused-ah pudichirukkaanga. Fake SIMs and mule bank accounts use panni epdi capital layer panraanga paarunga.

slides.title:
How Synthetic Companies
Trap Retail Money
slides.card_text: Scammers fake corporate records create panni, dummy directors-ah potu pre-IPO and penny stocks-la market manipulation panraanga. Retail investors indha MCA credentials-ah cross-verify pannama invest panni heavy loss-ku ulla aaguraanga.

slides.title:
Why Local Arrests Don't
Fix The Root Problem
slides.card_text: Oru chinna local agent-ah arrest panradhnala macro-level market manipulation nirkadhu. Institutional players and operators indha dummy structures-ah use panni liquidity drain panraanga. Safe-ah irukka unga due diligence romba mukkiyam.

slides.title:
The Golden Rule Of
Capital Protection
slides.card_text: Oru unlisted share-la ya private placement vehicle-la money deploy panravangala? First MCA21 portal-ku poi DIN filings, active filing history, and auditor credentials-ah mandatory-ah check pannunga.

checklist_data.text: Quick commission ku bank account mattum rent-ku tharuvathu
MCA21 portal-la company active status and DIN filings check panradhu
Unverified private placement or unlisted shares-ah skip panradhu
